head: 9e57a95 (report commit; code head is its parent)

requirements.what_changed: /api/support requires opsauth (503 unconfigured, 401 missing/wrong). main.CUSTOMER_DATA_ROUTES declares customer-content routes; _operator_read_refusal is the shared guard. An enumeration test fetches every parameterless GET route (from app.routes) with no credential against seeded Customer/Order/SupportCase sentinels; only /api/support leaked, now closed.
requirements.remaining: The HTML dashboard and read-only aggregate routes stay unauthenticated by design (the test proves they carry no customer fields). Role-based separation beyond route-level is not built.

requirements.what_changed: Security half done: customer message text is no longer readable without the operator credential (same change as F-696).
requirements.remaining: The CX workspace that joins messages, orders, reviews and refunds does not exist; Etsy message/review/refund ingestion is gated on transactions_r (clusters B/D).

requirements.what_changed: ops/health.read capability signals (model_gateway, integrations, rendered_pages) now read the recorded probe rows the executor gates read (model.probe, etsy.probe, browser.probe). A configured but unproven key reads UNKNOWN; env presence is reported only as evidence.configured.
requirements.consumer: ops.health sweep (runtime/release.py handler, cadence health_sweep), /api/console, /api/health-signals, dashboard Health block

requirements.what_changed: ops/dependencies.map_state adds a per-row capability (PROVEN/UNPROVEN/UNKNOWN) from the executor gate predicates (PROBE_GATES) plus a configured_but_unproven list. 'configured' stays as a named config fact. Health matches the gate answer for the same row.
requirements.live_root: GET /api/dependencies; ops.dependencies sweep already used gates
requirements.remaining: The etsy_shop gate itself still ANDs ETSY_SHOP_NAME/ID with usability (GATES semantics, outside E's remit).

requirements.what_changed: executor.approval_inbox is the one owner surface. OwnerAction rows are bound to gates by requirement_key (direct or OWNER_ACTION_GATE_ALIASES) and merged into the gate card. Rows whose gate is open are withheld (satisfied_but_open). Unbound rows become standalone decision cards. The dashboard's legacy 'Owner action required' block was removed; /api/owner-actions serves the inbox.
requirements.remaining: /api/status owner_actions_open still counts the raw table (pinned by test_status_numbers_equal_sql). It is not rendered as an owner surface.

requirements.what_changed: Cards are emitted only for closed OWNER-kind gates with parked requirements (counted via gated_requirements, registry included). Gates that unblock nothing go to suppressed_unblocks_nothing; 'customers' goes to waiting_on_data.

Closed gates classified EXTERNAL-BLOCKED by closure.kind_of (rendered_pages, model_bearing_render) are listed under external_capability_unavailable with closure's reason and rendered in a separate 'External capability unavailable' block. They are never owner cards.
One ranked queue (sorted by cost, minutes, unblocks). Each card carries evidence (the gate condition) and steps. Duplicate legacy rows for a closed gate merge into one card.
requirements.remaining: Deploy to clear the production 19/20 duplicate. Evidence is the gate's check text, not a URL. Standalone decision cards carry only what their OwnerAction row stored.

requirements.what_changed: /api/verify adds check no_satisfied_owner_action_presented: it re-evaluates each presented card's gate via GATE_BY_KEY[...].open and fails if any is open or if an external gate is presented as an owner card. Withheld stale rows are included as evidence.
The headline 'Dead letters' card renders 'N expected / M defects' (dashboard_truth.dead_letter_split from st['dead_letter_refusals'/'dead_letter_defects']). The unsplit number is no longer shown.

scale.confidence.probability returns state MEASURED/UNMEASURED, reported_probability (None while the #275 evidence gate is unmet), modelled_bound and display ('UNMEASURED / insufficient commercial evidence'). The honest_statement no longer says 'Effectively zero'. The dashboard CA$5K row renders display. The numeric 'probability' key is kept as the internal conservative bound for existing consumers.
requirements.remaining: JSON consumers that read the raw 'probability' key (finance/reinvestment, growth/weekly, scale/evidence) still see the modelled bound. They should switch to reported_probability/state (other clusters).

requirements.what_changed: dashboard_truth.launch_inventory: a product is launch-cleared only if it is certified AND has an approved, hashed, unblocked ListingAsset AND is a current creative-gate survivor AND meets the gauge standard. The gauge standard is not assessable in E, so it blocks clearance (UNASSESSED is not passed). The headline shows 'Launch-cleared / certified N / M'.
requirements.remaining: The canonical launch_cleared belongs in launch/readiness.py with the real gauge-in-yarn-band check (cluster C). Until then the count is 0 by construction.

requirements.what_changed: Creative-gate survivors are in the top headline grid, flagged as an alarm when 0 with the dominant failure named.

The headline grid now leads with launch-cleared/certified, creative survivors, benchmark status, commercial evidence (sales with evidence_ref, orders), the owner queue and the dead-letter split. Queue, listing images, content pieces, certified releases, opex and revenue move to a 'Volume and operations' grid labelled 'not business readiness'.

The dashboard header shows commit_short and branch (core.build.identity), container start time (runner worker_started_at) and the last clean /api/verify time. Each /api/verify outcome is persisted as an AuditLog 'verify.completed' row {ok, failing, commit}.
requirements.remaining: Deploy time is the container start (a proxy, labelled 'container started'). No platform deploy timestamp is read.

requirements.what_changed: Every _block renders an 'as of' query time. Each headline KPI carries evidence.as_of.
requirements.remaining: The as-of is the render/query time, not the latest source row time. The non-block tables (jobs, products, incidents, audit) carry no separate as-of.

requirements.what_changed: Contradiction tests were added: refusal-only dead letters render '0 defects'; an open etsy_shop gate plus an open 'open shop' OwnerAction never renders and verify stays green; no external or data gate is presented as an owner card; no duplicate card for one decision.
dashboard_truth.evidence(): an envelope {source, as_of, transform, confidence, reconciliation, external_ids} on every headline KPI. New GET /api/headline serves them.
requirements.consumer: GET /api/headline, dashboard headline cards (source/as-of shown, transform in the title attribute)
requirements.remaining: The envelope is not yet on /api/console, /api/finance or /api/launch. The provenance backfill (275 unproven artefacts) needs a deploy plus ops.provenance_backfill.

tests_changed.why: It read /api/support unauthenticated, which F-696 forbids. It now asserts 401 without the credential and reads with it.
It asserted HEALTHY from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY presence, a self-grading label. It now asserts UNKNOWN until a recorded probe succeeds, then HEALTHY.
It pinned the words 'Effectively zero', which F-189 forbids. It now asserts state UNMEASURED, reported None and the display text; the modelled bound is still < 0.05.
It asserted the unsplit dead-letter total as the card value. It now asserts 'N expected / M defects' from SQL.

needs_from_others: Cluster C: a canonical launch_cleared(product) in launch/readiness.py with the gauge-within-yarn-band standard. dashboard_truth.launch_inventory should then call it instead of treating gauge as UNASSESSED.

Cluster D (finance/reinvestment.py) and growth/scale owners: read confidence.probability()['reported_probability'] / ['state'] instead of the raw 'probability' bound where a figure is shown to a person.

Any cluster adding a route that returns customer/order/support rows: add its path to main.CUSTOMER_DATA_ROUTES and guard it with _operator_read_refusal (tests/test_customer_data_auth.py fails otherwise).
Integrator: the owner's scripts or heartbeat that call GET /api/support must now send Authorization: Bearer $BRAMBLELOOP_OPS_TOKEN.
risks: GET /api/verify now writes one AuditLog row per call (verify.completed). A caller polling verify often will grow the audit log.
The dashboard runs creative.audit.audit_catalogue twice per render (headline and the Creative standard block).

OWNER_ACTION_GATE_ALIASES is hand-maintained. An OwnerAction key that names a gate under an unlisted alias is shown as a standalone decision; it is not hidden, so the failure mode is a possible duplicate, not a lost request.
/api/status owner_actions_open still counts the raw OwnerAction table (kept because an existing SQL-equality test pins it). The headline uses the inbox count.
